title: Aliens' anti-gravity methods: homopolar generator and Biefeld-Brown effect

tellings.quote: Yeah, one of one is is a home polar generator.

plain: Steve Coburn, a scientist who says he studies objects believed to be implanted in people by aliens and who describes himself as a witness, told podcast host Jesse Michels how he thinks a craft seen over Fillmore, California, could defy gravity. He says one method is a homopolar generator, a simple machine that makes electricity from a spinning disc in a magnetic field, and he links it to the Biefeld-Brown effect, a claimed push produced by high-voltage electric charge.
